name: Relics of the Past

start.dialog: I'm studying the ancient civilizations that lived here before the Mire formed. There are ruins in the depths with fascinating artifacts. Would you help me excavate them?
start.objective: Explore Mire ruins and help Hope excavate ancient artifacts

progress.dialog: These artifacts... they're from the Progenitor era! This could rewrite history books! Keep looking!

complete.dialog: Amazing finds! This will make my thesis legendary! Thank you for the help. Here - a boomerang from the excavation. It's surprisingly effective in combat!

party_comments.kade: History is important. Even buried history.
party_comments.sova: Progenitor artifacts should be studied carefully. Properly.

hidden_outcome: If you find the 'Progenitor Control Chip', Hope gives you 'Airwing' - a powerful ranged weapon
